title: Optimistic Like Update
prompt: A React feed applies an optimistic like update before the server responds. Write a helper that returns a new post object with liked flipped and likeCount increased by 1 when becoming liked or decreased by 1 when becoming unliked.

explanation.beginner: Start by identifying what the function receives and what it must return. For Optimistic Like Update, read the story as a simple input-to-output rule: A React feed applies an optimistic like update before the server responds. Write a helper that returns a new post object with liked flipped and likeCount increased by 1 when becoming liked or decreased by 1 when becoming unliked. Work through one small example by hand, then write the steps in React using plain variables before worrying about making the code shorter.
